title: Reconciliation API profile validation
description: Schema that can be used to validate the basic configuration of a schema with type `ReconciliationProfile`.

suggestEntity.description: Configuration options for the Suggest Entity service.

mwquery.description: Query parameters for the Suggest Entity service with MediaWiki core.

namespaces.description: An array of MediaWiki namespaces to be searched. For the main namespace, write `Main`.

categories.description: An array of MediaWiki categories to be searched.

substringPattern.description: The pattern used to match the query string against the entity names.

smwquery.description: Query parameters for the Suggest Entity service with Semantic MediaWiki.

statement.description: Configuration and components of the query statement for SMW. You are free to use multiple statements, which will be strung together with the OR operator.

from.description: The base query condition, without variables.

where.description: The pattern matching condition of the query. After the operator, a tilde (`~`) or `like:`, use `@@@` as a placeholder for the user provided substring (or whatever the `placeholder` parameter is set to). Do NOT add asterisk wildcards and `+/-` boolean operators: they will be automatically applied according to the substring pattern and search engine settings that you use.

substringPattern.description: The pattern used to match the query string against the entity names.

preprocessSubstring.description: SMW only. The only option currently allowed is `flatten`: this applies case and accent folding and removes punctuation, which can be helpful if you have similarly optimised a semantic property for fuzzy phrase matching in LIKE statements and need to preprocess the substring to a ‘dumbed down’ version.

comment.description: Comment for internal use, which will be ignored by the API.

output.description: Configuration for the result output of the Suggest Entity service, such as the name/label, description and image of the entity as well as sort/order options. Used for both SMW and MW core.

name.description: Configuration for the entity's name or label.

smwproperty.description: Name of the semantic property used to provide the entity's name or label. If set, takes precedence over `useDisplayTitle` and `hideNamespacePrefix`. If it is not set, the entity's name will be taken from the page name and the `useDisplayTitle` and `hideNamespacePrefix` settings apply. If you need to enforce the exclusive use of pagenames rather than properties, set smwproperty to `false`.

mwproperty.description: Currently not used but reserved for future use to provide the entity's name through native MediaWiki functionality.

useDisplayTitle.description: Whether to use the display title of the page, relying on native MediaWiki functionality.

hideNamespacePrefix.description: In the absence of a display title, whether to hide the namespace prefix from the pagenames.

smwproperty.description: Optionally, name of the semantic property used to provide the entity's description.

image.description: Configuration for associating an entity with an image, typically a thumbnail.

smwproperty.description: Name of the semantic property that holds the image filename. If omitted, the default property set in `$wgReconAPIThumbnailProp` will be used.

extension.description: May be set to `PageImages` to fetch the image thumbnail through the PageImages extension

sort.description: Name of the semantic property that is used to sort the results. Maps to the `sort` parameter of an SMW query. If not set, the results are sorted by the entity's name.

order.description: Sort order of the results. Maps to the `order` parameter of an SMW query. If not set, the results are sorted in ascending order.

defaultTypes.description: An array of types that are considered “good generic choices for reconciliation”.

redirect.description: Configuration for the redirect service, which is used to redirect users to a specific page if no direct match is found.

queryPage.description: Name of the query page to which users should be sent if no direct match is found.

query.description: Parameters of the URL query string. The final parameter should be the one holding the query phrase, without an empty string.

smwproperty.description: Name of the semantic property that indicates whether or not the page is and should be accessible.

pass.description: Values that indicate a page is accessible.

fail.description: Values that indicate a page is inaccessible.

updateUrl.description: The URL component to which the query data should be added: either `search` (default, can be omitted) for the URL search/query string or `fragment` for the URL fragment identifier.
